title: RAGVUE: A Diagnostic View for Explainable and Automated Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Keerthana Murugaraj; Salima Lamsiyah; Martin Theobald
why_relevant: Proposes a diagnostic, reference-free RAG evaluation framework decomposing retrieval quality, grounding faithfulness, and judge calibration, relevant to evaluation metrics for unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on evaluation tooling rather than directly studying robustness to noise, conflict, or attacks.
